title: Opening a bank account as a foreigner
question: Can a foreigner open a bank account in Poland without a PESEL number?
short_answer: Yes. Most banks allow account opening with a passport and residence permit.
conditions: Valid passport or national ID is required
Residence permit (karta pobytu) or registration certificate (zaświadczenie o zameldowaniu) is helpful
Some banks require a PESEL number — apply at your local municipality (urząd gminy)
Some banks offer accounts for foreigners without PESEL (e.g. PKO BP, Santander, mBank, ING)
exceptions: EU citizens can open accounts with their EU national ID
Ukrainian citizens can open accounts with their Ukrainian passport (since 2022)
Some fintech apps (Revolut, Wise) do not require PESEL at all
